market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver at $120 implies over a 3.5× rally from current ~$34–35 in ~18 months, an extreme tail event far beyond its all-time high near $50. Historical volatility and fundamentals suggest this is implausible; even with tail risk the probability is under 1%. The market's 6.6% implied probability is far too high.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time high is ~$50 (1980, 2011), making $120 a 2.4× ATH and a 3.5× current price jump in just 1.5 years.
Implied volatility for silver is ~30% p.a.; lognormal models give a <0.1% chance of exceeding $120 by mid-2026.

Fundamentals (mine supply, industrial demand, no monetary premium like gold) do not support a sudden multi-fold price explosion absent a hyperinflationary regime change, which has negligible near-term probability.
